text:
Neha Bari.
    

    
      ABOUT
      PROJECTS
    
  

  
    
      
        

        
          Hi, I am Neha! Welcome. My spirit cartoon is Bugs Bunny,
          and on this website I want to show my projects and side hobbies.
        

        
          VIEW PROJECTS ↘
          
            SAY HI TO BUNNY ↗
          
        
      

      
        
        
        
          Eh… what’s up, doc?
        
      
    

    
      01 / ABOUT

      
        A littleabout me.

        
          
            I’m Neha Bari Tamboli. My experience includes industry
            projects with TU Eindhoven, Philips, and Enexis.
          
          
            I work with Python, SQL, PySpark, Azure Databricks,
            and Delta Lake, across data processing, forecasting,
            and machine learning.
          
          
            I hold an M.Sc. in Computing Science from the University
            of Groningen. My EngD Data Science work at TU Eindhoven
            combines research with practical industry challenges.
          
        
      
    

    
      
        
          02 / PROJECTS
          My work.
        
      

      
        
          
            TU EINDHOVEN · 2025–2026
          
          Restaurant Digitalization
          
            Gathered input from four restaurants and 65 customers,
            translating the findings into 35 prioritized requirements
            for an AI ordering assistant.
          
          
            Built a scheduled Databricks workflow to validate
            221 simulated customer sessions and stored validated
            data in Delta Lake.
          
          
            Analyzed ordering interface variants with SQL and developed
            Logistic Regression and XGBoost models for order completion,
            achieving approximately 0.79 ROC AUC.
          
          
            PYTHON · SQL · DATABRICKS · DELTA LAKE
          
        

        
          
            ENEXIS · 2024
          
          Electricity Forecasting
          
            Developed PySpark workflows in Azure Databricks to prepare
            electricity load records for forecasting.
          
          
            Created lag, rolling average, and calendar features.
            The data processing workflow ran in 1 minute and 2 seconds
            in the development environment.
          
          
            Used chronological training for a GRU forecasting model,
            achieving 7.63% MAPE.
          
          
            PYSPARK · DATABRICKS · GRU
          
        

        
          
            PHILIPS · 2024–2025
          
          Digital Pathology
          
            Managed an Agile project exploring intelligent assignment
            of pathology cases, working with Philips’ Pathology team.
          
          
            Assessed database schemas and documented six high-priority
            and five medium-priority data quality gaps.
          
          
            Aligned open-source data with Philips’ schema and explained
            the implications of data gaps to nontechnical stakeholders.
          
          
            DATA QUALITY · DATA MODELING · AGILE
          
        

        
          
            UNIVERSITY OF GRONINGEN · 2021
          
          Learning from Brain Scans
          
            Integrated FDG PET data from three hospitals into a consistent
            dataset and corrected hospital-specific bias for my
            master’s thesis.
          
          
            Extended and evaluated a neural network classifier on
            175 cases, achieving approximately 85% AUROC,
            and assessed feature relevance.
          
          
            NEURAL NETWORKS · NEUROIMAGING · MODEL EVALUATION
          
        
      
    

    
      03 / EXPERIENCE

      
        Beyondthe projects.

        
          
            Tata Consultancy Services · 2016–2018
          
          
            For client Morgan Stanley, supported production batch job
            migrations across regions, monitored execution against SLA
            windows, and reported failed or delayed runs.
          

          Other industry projects · 2024
          
            Analyzed 42 machine sensor signals for Omron, clustered
            30,000 customer records into eight load-profile segments
            for Alliander, and led a team analyzing over 500,000
            skating records for KNSB.
